t: 陆军工程兵团的成立是为了在西点发现并运营美国军事学院.
te: The Army Corps of Engineers is established to found and operate the United States Military Academy at West Point.
dz: 陆军工程兵团的成立是为了在西点发现并运营美国军事学院.
de: The Army Corps of Engineers is established to found and operate the United States Military Academy at West Point.

t: "阿米恩斯条约"是法国与英国签订的"明确和平条约".
te: The Treaty of Amiens is signed as a "Definitive Treaty of Peace" between France and the United Kingdom.
dz: "阿米恩斯条约"是法国与英国签订的"明确和平条约".
de: The Treaty of Amiens is signed as a "Definitive Treaty of Peace" between France and the United Kingdom.

t: 海因里希·威廉·马特豪斯·奥尔伯斯(英语:Heinrich Wilhelm Matthäus …
te: Heinrich Wilhelm Matthäus Olbers discovers 2 Pallas, the second asteroid ever to be discovered.
dz: 海因里希·威廉·马特豪斯·奥尔伯斯(英语:Heinrich Wilhelm Matthäus Olbers)发现了2个帕拉斯,是有史以来第二颗被发现的小行星.
de: Heinrich Wilhelm Matthäus Olbers discovers 2 Pallas, the second asteroid ever to be discovered.

t: 12 000名瓦哈比人将卡尔巴拉解雇,杀害了3 000多居民.
te: Twelve thousand Wahhabis sack Karbala, killing over three thousand inhabitants.
dz: 12 000名瓦哈比人将卡尔巴拉解雇,杀害了3 000多居民.
de: Twelve thousand Wahhabis sack Karbala, killing over three thousand inhabitants.

t: 拿破仑·波拿巴签署大赦令,让法国大革命最臭名昭著的移民中除约一千人外,其余全部回法国.
te: Napoleon Bonaparte signs a general amnesty to allow all but about one thousand of the most notorious émigrés of the Fre…
dz: 拿破仑·波拿巴签署大赦令,让法国大革命最臭名昭著的移民中除约一千人外,其余全部回法国.
de: Napoleon Bonaparte signs a general amnesty to allow all but about one thousand of the most notorious émigrés of the French Revolution to return to France.

t: 国会废除了华盛顿特区的创始政府——专员委员会后，华盛顿特区成为一座城市。 “华盛顿市”采用市长…
te: Washington, D.C. is incorporated as a city after Congress abolishes the Board of Commissioners, the District's founding…
dz: 国会废除了华盛顿特区的创始政府——专员委员会后，华盛顿特区成为一座城市。 “华盛顿市”采用市长理事会形式的政府。
de: Washington, D.C. is incorporated as a city after Congress abolishes the Board of Commissioners, the District's founding government. The "City of Washington" is given a mayor-council form of government.

t: 拿破仑·波拿巴创立了荣誉军团勋章。
te: Napoleon Bonaparte founds the Legion of Honour.
dz: 拿破仑·波拿巴创立了荣誉军团勋章。
de: Napoleon Bonaparte founds the Legion of Honour.

t: 根据 1802 年 5 月 20 日的法律，拿破仑·波拿巴在法国殖民地恢复了奴隶制，撤销了法国…
te: By the Law of 20 May 1802, Napoleon Bonaparte reinstates slavery in the French colonies, revoking its abolition in the …
dz: 根据 1802 年 5 月 20 日的法律，拿破仑·波拿巴在法国殖民地恢复了奴隶制，撤销了法国大革命中废除的奴隶制。
de: By the Law of 20 May 1802, Napoleon Bonaparte reinstates slavery in the French colonies, revoking its abolition in the French Revolution.

t: 在瓜德罗普,由路易·德尔格雷斯所领导的400名叛逆的奴隶自爆了而不是屈服于拿破仑的军队.
te: In Guadeloupe, 400 rebellious slaves, led by Louis Delgrès, blow themselves up rather than submit to Napoleon's troops.
dz: 在瓜德罗普,由路易·德尔格雷斯所领导的400名叛逆的奴隶自爆了而不是屈服于拿破仑的军队.
de: In Guadeloupe, 400 rebellious slaves, led by Louis Delgrès, blow themselves up rather than submit to Napoleon's troops.

te: King Charles Emmanuel IV of Sardinia abdicates his throne in favor of his brother, Victor Emmanuel.
dz: 撒丁岛国王查理·埃马纽埃尔四世放弃了自己的王位,支持他的兄弟维克多·埃马纽埃尔.
de: King Charles Emmanuel IV of Sardinia abdicates his throne in favor of his brother, Victor Emmanuel.

t: 美国军事学院在纽约西点开学.
te: The United States Military Academy opens at West Point, New York.
dz: 美国军事学院在纽约西点开学.
de: The United States Military Academy opens at West Point, New York.

t: 嘉隆皇帝征服河内，统一经历了数百年封建战争的越南。
te: Emperor Gia Long conquers Hanoi and unified Viet Nam, which had experienced centuries of feudal warfare.
dz: 嘉隆皇帝征服河内，统一经历了数百年封建战争的越南。
de: Emperor Gia Long conquers Hanoi and unified Viet Nam, which had experienced centuries of feudal warfare.

te: France annexes the Kingdom of Piedmont.
dz: 法国吞并皮埃蒙特王国。
de: France annexes the Kingdom of Piedmont.
